name: MapScreen - Summary
description: The whole screen at the map's last phase, which is now the SAME screen as every other phase. Reaching the end used to swap this workspace for a page of paper cards, and that swap said two things the product does not believe: that the thinking was over, and that the plan is a different object from the map it came out of. The board stays, and what the map produced stands at the far end of it — still pannable, still answerable.
